transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: The Phuket Smart Bus stop is outside the domestic terminal at exit 3. The airport–Rawai route passes through Surin, Kamala, Patong, Karon and Kata.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: The free network is called “@ Airport Free Wi-Fi by NT”. To connect, enter an email address and accept the terms of use. Internet access is available for 60 minutes after the connection is confirmed.
